retraction.reason: Retracted in M22: the Madeiran regional election of 22 September 2019. The atlas keeps the first exercise of an institution and the ballot at which it became a cycle, and retracts the routine repetitions after them; the twelfth Madeiran regional election is one. The only link available is the constitutional one the earlier records already carry. Revisit if a consequence is written.
